units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 7:2:26">Y. Sabb. VII, 10ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>ג׳ מלאכתו</he> when he gives to his work the finishing touch; a. fr.
<cite ref="Mishnah Pesachim 10:7">Pes. X, 7</cite> <he>גּוֹמֵר עליו את ההלל</he> he reads over it (the fourth cup) the Hallel to the end, v. <cite ref="E00573"><he>הַלֵּל</he></cite>.—
Tosef. Succ. III, 2 גּוֹמְרִין בהן וכ׳ on those occasions the entire Hallel is read; Ber. 14ᵃ; Arakh. 10ᵃ; Taan. 28ᵇ.
<cite ref="Berakhot 13b:19">Ber. 13ᵇ</cite> <he>חוזר וגוֹמְרָהּ</he> (after the disciples left) did he take it up again and read the whole of the Sh’ma?—
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Yevamot 2:1:3">Y. Yeb. II, beg. 3ᶜ</cite> <he>הביאה גוֹמֶרֶת בה</he> coition consummates the levir’s marriage (Bab.

Y. Ber. VI, 10ᵈ top ג׳ מלאכול after he has finished eating; a. fr.—Euphem. to gratify the sexual appetite.

senses.gloss: שהכל גּוֹמְרִים בה all people could gratify their lust on her.—וְגוֹמֵר (abbr. וגו׳, וג׳) and one finishes (the sentence quoted) = and so forth, &c., a clerical term used in Bible citations to save the writing out of the entire quotation.
units: <cite ref="Chullin 98a">Ḥull. 98ᵃ</cite>.
Gen. R. s. 51, beg.; a. fr.—*Part. pass. גָּמוּר, f. גְּמוּרָה finished, complete, real, valid.
<cite ref="Kiddushin 40b:6">Kidd. 40ᵇ</cite>, a. fr. <he>צדיק ג׳</he> a perfectly righteous man (without faults); <he>רשע ג׳</he> a wicked man throughout (without any good quality).
<cite ref="Yevamot 18b:7">Yeb. 18ᵇ</cite>, a. fr. <he>קניין ג׳</he> real (legal) possession.—Pl. <he>גְּמוּרִים</he>, <he>גְּמוּרוֹת</he>.
<cite ref="Chullin 89a:4">Ḥull. 89ᵃ</cite>; a. fr.—
Bets. 2ᵇ, a. e. בצים ג׳ perfectly developed eggs (with shells), v. infra.—3) to destroy.
Pes. 87ᵇ (play on Gomer, v. supra) בזזו וגָמְרוּ (Ms. M. גמרו וגמרו) they plundered and destroyed (they destroyed thoroughly).
<cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 16:1">Kel. XVI, 1</cite>.
<cite ref="Berakhot 17a:7">Ber. 17ᵃ</cite> <he>גְּמוֹר בכל לבבך וכ׳</he> be determined with all thy heart &c.
<cite ref="Shevuot 26b:15">Shebu. 26ᵇ</cite> <he>ג׳ בלבו</he> he resolved (vowed) in his heart, opp. <he>הוציא בשפתיו</he>; <cite ref="Chagigah 10a:11">Ḥag. 10ᵃ</cite>.—
<cite ref="Eruvin 13b">Erub. 13ᵇ</cite>, a. fr. <he>נמנו וגמרו</he> they were counted (their votes were taken) and they decided.—
<cite ref="Mishnah Sanhedrin 3:7">Snh. III, 7</cite> (<cite ref="Sanhedrin 42a:19">42ᵃ</cite>) <he>גמרו את הדבר</he> when they had closed the case (being ready for publishing the sentence); a. fr.
Sabb. 96ᵇ ג׳ העברה העברה מיוה״כ one forms an analogy between the expressions heĕbir &c.; a. fr.
<cite ref="Tosefta Parah 11:7">Tosef. Par. XI, 7</cite>, v. <cite ref="C01037"><he>גָּמַל</he></cite>.—<he>בצים גמורות</he>, v. supra.
<cite ref="Pesachim 87b">Pes. 87ᵇ</cite> <he>בקשו לגַמֵּר וכ׳</he> they intented to destroy the possessions of Israel in her (Gomer’s) days, v. supra.

senses.gloss: to develop, mature, ripen. Y. Shebi. V, beg. 35ᵈ אין פירותיה׳ מְגַמְּרִין וכ׳ their fruits ripen only every three years.
